findings.issue: Token この is glossed 'nine' — completely wrong word (confusion with 九/ここの). この is the demonstrative determiner 'this' (modifying 瓶).
Gloss 'nove' (the number nine) is wrong for この; it is the demonstrative 'este/esta' (qualifica 瓶).
Wrong reading of 開かない in context: for a jar lid that won't open, 開く is read あく (intransitive 'become open'), so ふたが開かない = あかない, not ひらかない.
findings.current: このじゃむのびん、ふたがかたくてひらかないよ。
findings.suggested: このじゃむのびん、ふたがかたくてあかないよ。

findings.issue: Reading ひらか is wrong in this context; ふたが開かない uses 開く=あく, so the negative stem is あか.

False conjugation claim: godan 話す has no colloquial negative 話しない, and it is not a 'relaxed' 話さない (relaxation gives 話さん etc.). The form is noun 話+(を)しない (negative of する), or at best a nonstandard analogical negation that must be flagged as nonstandard.
findings.current: in the colloquial negative form 話しない (= relaxed 話さない)
findings.suggested: with 話 as the noun 'talk' and を omitted: 話(を)しない, negative of する = 'we don't do that much talking'

findings.issue: Same false grammar claim as expl_en: 話しない is presented as negativa coloquial 'relaxada' de 話さない, which is not a real colloquial process for verbos godan; the correct analysis is substantivo 話 + (を)しない.
findings.current: na forma negativa coloquial 話しない (= 話さない relaxado)
findings.suggested: com 話 como substantivo ('conversa') e を omitido: 話(を)しない, negativa de する = 'não se conversa tanto assim'

findings.issue: Stray duplicated tokens: tokens[0] お and tokens[1] 金 (all-null glosses) are prepended before 彼, breaking sentence order; お金 is already correctly tokenized later in the sequence. Both stray tokens should be deleted.
findings.suggested: (delete tokens[0] お and tokens[1] 金; お金 already appears at its correct position)

findings.issue: Mirrors the kana reading error: hirakanai should be akanai (ふたがあかない).
Literal reads as an English imperative ('Don't talk that much') but the sentence is declarative ('[we] don't talk that much'), as the en field itself shows; this changes the sense of the mirror.
Learner-facing note contains a leftover QA meta-comment — "(a glosa 'to print' está errada)" / "(the gloss 'to print' is wrong)" — about a gloss that no longer exists in the record.
findings.current: し é parte da locução fixa, não um する produtivo (a glosa 'to print' está errada)
findings.suggested: Drop the parenthetical in both locales: 'し é parte da locução fixa, não um する produtivo' / 'し is part of the fixed phrase, not a productive する'

findings.issue: Internal authoring jargon leaked into learner-facing text: 'The target is coverage' refers to the pipeline's grammar-target tag and is meaningless to a learner.
findings.current: The target is coverage, practicing a color adjective + a verb in the continuous past aspect ています/ていた.
findings.suggested: This sentence practices a color adjective + a verb in the past continuous aspect ていた.

findings.issue: Same internal jargon leak as expl_en: 'O alvo é cobertura (coverage)' is pipeline metadata, not learner content.
findings.current: O alvo é cobertura (coverage), praticando adjetivo de cor + verbo no aspecto contínuo ています/ていた no passado.
findings.suggested: A frase pratica adjetivo de cor + verbo no aspecto contínuo ていた no passado.

findings.issue: References an internal grammar-target list that is invisible to learners ('none of the list's patterns is genuinely used'); confusing in learner-facing text.
findings.current: so none of the list's patterns is genuinely used.
findings.suggested: End the sentence at: ひょっとしたら is a fixed locution, not the conditional 'if/supposing that'.

findings.issue: Same internal-list reference as expl_en: 'nenhum padrão da lista é genuinamente usado' refers to authoring metadata the learner never sees.
findings.current: por isso nenhum padrão da lista é genuinamente usado.
findings.suggested: Terminar a frase em: ひょっとしたら é uma locução fixa, não o condicional 'se/supondo que'.
